issues.description: Method mismatch for Farm.addAnimal: The UML in problem_statement.md declares addAnimal(animal: Animal): boolean, while the solution implementation in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java defines public void addAnimal(Animal animal). The template Main (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java) invokes farm.addAnimal(...) and does not use a return value. This inconsistency between the documented API (boolean) and the implemented signature (void) can confuse students about the expected return type and whether they should handle a boolean result.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the API consistent across artifacts. Either (A) update the problem statement UML and textual description to declare addAnimal(Animal): void to match the implementation and leave template example calls unchanged, or (B) change the implementation to return boolean (for example: public boolean addAnimal(Animal animal) { return animals.add(animal); }) and update any example/template calls and the UML to use boolean. Ensure tests and example code reflect the chosen signature.
